say: Hand work to AI, and it often stalls at ninety percent.|The draft is ready,|but you still paste it into the system and hit send yourself.
sub: 交给 AI 的活，经常卡在九成|草稿写好了|最后还得你自己贴进系统、点发送

say: Grok Bot closes that last ten percent.|It's a team of always-on AI teammates|that actually finish the job.
sub: Grok Bot 想补上最后这一成|它是一支全天候在线的 AI 队友|能把活儿直接做完

say: Every Bot has its own computer in the cloud.|It signs into your tools and opens websites, just like you do,|even systems with no API.
sub: 每个 Bot 都有一台自己的云端电脑|像你一样登录工具、打开网页|没有接口的系统也能操作

say: Step away from your desk, and it keeps working.|It comes back when the job is done,|and only pings you when it needs your approval.
sub: 你离开电脑，它照样在干|做完了才回来|只有需要你批准的时候才打扰你

say: Handing off work is like messaging a coworker,|from your phone or your desktop,|and you can pick up the same thread anytime.
sub: 交代任务就像给同事发消息|手机和电脑都能发|同一个对话随时接着聊

say: No workflows to build, no automations to set up.|Just say what you need.
sub: 不用先搭流程、写自动化|直接说你要什么就行

say: You can run several Bots at once.|One acts as chief,|and the others each own a lane: inbox, expenses, recruiting, bug fixes.
sub: 还可以同时开好几个 Bot|一个当总管|其余各管一摊：收件箱、报销、招聘、修 bug

say: They message each other and share context,|split up tasks in a group chat,|and only bring you the calls that need a decision.
sub: 它们会互相发消息、共享上下文|在群里自己分派任务|只把需要拍板的事交给你

say: To teach it a workflow, let it watch you do it once.|It saves that as a routine,|and runs it on its own next time.
sub: 想教它一个流程，就让它看你做一遍|它会存成固定流程|下次自己跑

say: The longer you work together, the more it learns your habits and your voice,|when to ask,|and when to just do it.
sub: 合作越久，它越懂你的习惯和口吻|知道什么时候该问|什么时候直接做

say: Take sales.|Overnight, it researches accounts and scores contacts,|drafts emails in each rep's voice,|and in the morning, you just approve.
sub: 比如销售|它连夜研究客户、给联系人打分|按每个人的口吻写好邮件草稿|第二天早上你批准就行

say: It's in beta now, on desktop and iOS.|SuperGrok and Cursor subscribers can try it first,|with its own usage, separate from your plan.
sub: 现在是测试版，桌面端和 iOS 都能用|SuperGrok 和 Cursor 的订阅用户可以先试|用量单独计算，不占原来的额度

say: Grok Bot.|The AI teammate that gets the work done.
sub: Grok Bot|能把活儿干完的 AI 队友
